title: Asa and Yuru
overview: In a world where certain humans command mighty supernatural duos called Daemons, it is the birthright of "the children who sunder day and night"—twins Yuru and Asa—to rule over these powerful entities. Separated from a young age and unaware of the truth of their birth, brother and sister must fight to make their way back to each other, claim their birthright, and save the world...

title: Right and Left
overview: Guided by Dera, Yuru flees from his pursuers and awakens the guardian deities of the village.

title: Dera and Hana
overview: Yuru learns the truth about his village and learns the rules of modern society as he rides down the mountain.

title: Jin and Yuru
overview: After a short rest, Yuru and his Daemons begin their search for Asa by sniffing out her blood.

title: Hare and Tortoise
overview: Yuru and his Daemons track the scent of Asa's blood to a warehouse, where they encounter Jin and his men.

title: The Kagemori Clan and the Unknown Assailants
overview: Yuru is reunited with Asa at the Kagemori mansion and asks her about their parents.

title: Asa and Break
overview: The morning after the battle, Yuru asks about the eyepatch covering her right eye.

title: Suspicion and Conviction
overview: Dera arrives at the Kagemori mansion to retrieve Yuru, and they're invited to breakfast by the clan head.

title: Embrace and Whisper
overview: In order to cheer Yuru up, Dera drags him and his Daemons around the city to see the sights.

title: Long-Arm and Long-Leg
overview: While shopping in the city, Yuru and Dera sense that they’re being followed.

title: Big Brother and Little Brother
overview: After defeating Long-Arm and Long-Leg, the group realizes something else had been tailing them all along.

title: Retainer and Shaman
overview: Ken moves in with Yuru and the others and asks Yuru to help him become stronger.

title: Daikyo and Shokyo
overview: Higashi Village is attacked by a man wielding katana Daemons.

title: Family and Friends
overview: Yuru and Ken notice someone following them while looking for a place to practice shooting a bow.

title: Yuru and Danji
overview: Feeling betrayed by Danji, Yuru asks for space so he can think by himself.

title: Kagemori and Shingo
overview: Yuru and Dera head to the warehouses at night to meet Ivan.

title: Crybaby and Naughty Child
overview: The traitor attacks Asa while she's alone, but the Kagemoris have set a trap for him.

title: Fujin and Raijin
overview: At the Kagemori mansion, the traitor is captured. Meanwhile, Gonzo overpowers the Shingo clan.

title: Sword and Bow
overview: Asa rescues the hostages, and Yuru faces off against Ivan.

title: The Hunted and the Hunter
overview: After an intense battle, Ivan escapes. He teleports back to Shingo, who appears to be in trouble.

title: Zashiki-Warashi and Higashi Village
overview: The Zashiki-Warashi, Danji and Kiri, tell Asa and Yuru what they know about Higashi Village.

title: The Kagemori Brothers and the Kuroya Siblings
overview: Natsuki demands to know why Akio betrayed the Kagemori clan, but he offers no explanation.
